title: Golden Hash Browns with Irish Potato Cakes
description: A delicious breakfast dish featuring crispy hash browns and fluffy Irish potato cakes.
instructions: 2. Peel and grate the Irish potatoes.
3. Squeeze out excess moisture from the grated potatoes.
4. Mix in the hash browns and golden oil.
5. Divide the mixture into 4 portions and shape each into a patty.
6. Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
8. Meanwhile, heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
9. Add a small amount of golden oil to the pan.
10. Cook the Irish potato cakes for 4-5 minutes on each side or until crispy and golden brown.
